explanation: Existing consequence collections are calculated, but the complete Debrief.Write implementation does not export Cases or AreaWatch as JSON collections, including when empty. Headless Report.Json delegates to this serializer; counts and descriptive lines cannot preserve every entry's structured values and associations. Repair only Debrief.cs: unconditionally serialize the existing collections under nextMission, preserving their order and all tuple fields, without changing calculations or existing fields. Existing scenario tests cover some in-memory consequences and replay checksums, but do not cover collection export, empty arrays, complete value preservation, repeated-read immutability, or exported replay equality. Those acceptance criteria remain unverified; no tests were run. No campaign persistence or new design values are needed.
